location: gs:IMO_053_ShipShape / property sh:path nltl:hasExtinguishingMedium / sh:nodeKind sh:IRI
problem: The requirement constrains the suitability status of every linked extinguishing medium but does not require each medium item to be identified by an IRI. This restriction rejects otherwise valid blank-node item representations and changes executable conformance.
required_change: Remove sh:nodeKind sh:IRI from the hasExtinguishingMedium property shape; preserve the relationship path and nested extinguishing-medium-item status constraint.
regression_guard: Preserve nltl:ship as the target and nltl:hasExtinguishingMedium as the relationship to the per-medium item constraint.
